The '''Malastare Narrows''' were a location in regards to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. They were [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench]] of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] as part of the [[Battle of Malastare Narrows/Legends|Battle of Malastare Narrows]] of [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Although the "Malastare Narrows" were first mentioned as part of the name of the Battle of Malastare Narrows, they were not identified as an actual location until the publication of ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''.
